summary: Every checkable claim in the report matches the checks, snapshot, rendered HTML and screenshots, and 'nothing outstanding' fits a run with 43/43 checks passed and only minor content-level issues from the grader.

claims.claim: Built entirely through the two Umbraco MCP servers
claims.evidence: check.json: process.intendedChannel ok, 'built through mcp-skills'; code.noMigrationsWritten ok

claims.claim: 4 block element types in Blocks/: heroBlock, richTextBlock, imageBlock, quoteBlock with listed properties
claims.evidence: grade.md 'What it built' and snapshot.json list these four elements in Blocks with the same properties

claims.claim: Blog Block Grid data type, 12 columns, allowing all four blocks
claims.evidence: grade.md: 'Blog Block Grid (12 columns, all four blocks)'; pages show data-grid-columns="12"

claims.claim: blogFrontPage (title/intro/blocks, allows blogPost) and blogPost (title/excerpt/hero image/blocks) in Pages/; siteRoot allows front page
claims.evidence: grade.md and snapshot.json allowedChildren entries; check.json schema.blockGridOnPages: blogFrontPage, blogPost
check.json counts.templates 3; changes list the three views

claims.claim: Media folder Blog with 4 Unsplash photos imported from unsplash/
claims.evidence: check.json content.hasMedia 4, content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos 4 of 4, content.mediaInFolders ok

claims.claim: Blog front page with domain /, hero + rich text block, Latest posts listing
claims.evidence: check.json content.domainAssigned 'Blog: /'; frontpage screenshot shows hero, welcome text, 'Latest posts' cards

claims.claim: Post 1: rich text ×2, quote block, hero image; Post 2: rich text ×2, image block with credited caption, hero image
claims.evidence: grade.md content breakdown; composable page HTML has a figcaption with 'Photo: Shubham Dhage, Unsplash'; blogpost screenshot shows hero image, paragraphs, quote

claims.claim: Templates use GetBlockGridHtmlAsync, no custom renderers or block loops; adapters → records → ViewComponents
claims.evidence: check.json code.pagesUseBlockGridHelper, noCustomBlockLoops, adapterPerBlock, adaptersInvokeViewComponents 4/4, viewComponentPerBlock 4 all ok

claims.claim: Tailwind built with npm run build to wwwroot/dist/site.css
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt ok, site.stylesheetsLoad 200; screenshots show styled dark Tailwind design
check.json crawl: /, both post URLs status 200; site.allPagesRender '3 page(s) OK'

claims.claim: Block grid markup, blockquote, figure and signed GetCropUrl media URLs render; images return 200
claims.evidence: pages/*.html contain umb-block-grid, blockquote and figcaption; check.json images 6/6 load, noUnsignedResizeUrls ok, all media URLs carry hmac

claims.claim: No 'Could not render component' fallbacks anywhere
claims.evidence: grep of pages/ finds no such text; crawl renderErrors empty on all pages
check.json 43 passed / 0 failed; grade.md finds only minor content issues (thin posts, no publish-date property, intro field not rendered) and no breakage

claims.claim: Two scaffold warnings (ImageSharp advisory, app URL auto-detection) are pre-existing
claims.evidence: check.json reports 10 build warnings, 0 errors; whether these existed before the run isn't shown in the provided evidence
